Team — forwarding Casey's note and the signed SOW. Quick summary and asks from Sales to CS: please own the kickoff & pilot delivery.

Deal summary (TL;DR)
- Account: NovaLegacy (deal NL-2026-7423)
- Contract: 3-month pilot, 200k token/month cap, SOW executed (attached)
- Target kickoff: week of June 7; customer prefers June 8
- Procurement: PO #NL-7423 received; copy to procurement@novalegacy.com

Key technical/context items (from discovery)
- Data: customer will provide a 25GB sample export (CSV/Parquet) and S3 access; IT contact is it-team@novalegacy.com
- Compliance: data residency in us-east-1, no cross-region backups requested for pilot
- Models: start with rdx-std-13B-quant but hold fallback to rdx-30B for quality checks; latency SLO <= 450ms median for 512 tokens
- Integrations: initial ingest via S3 -> Redwood Inference batch loader; webhook for inference results to their staging endpoint

Acceptance criteria (pilot):
1) Demo: customer runs three representative flows with <5% quality regression vs baseline
2) Latency: median inference <= 450ms for 512-token baseline in our dev harness
3) Data validation: automated schema checks + sample ingestion validated by customer

Immediate asks for kickstart
- Marissa: please nominate the Implementation Lead (owner for kickoff & delivery)
- Monica: please confirm capacity for a June 8 kickoff (pref. 9am PT start) and ownership of runbook creation
- Tessa: please prepare SOW-specific acceptance checklist and test-set / eval prompts we should validate during pilot
- Priyom: confirm billing trigger (when to mark deal moved to post-sign billing) and attach any required PO docs to the record

Attachments: SOW_signed_NovaLegacy.pdf (from customer)

I'll send a customer-facing kickoff confirmation once we align owners and the agenda.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
